scrapedInfo.finding: Victoria Nikitin is Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and has finance, data analytics, reimbursement, and Medicaid waiver priority background.
Financial Assistance eligibility uses online, mail, expedited, and drop-off workflows with proof documents and processing windows.
Eligibility connects to appointment access through published call center workflows.
Published Harris materials list Victoria.Nikitin@harrishealth.org as a contact address.

draftSubject: Enhancing Revenue Cycle and Eligibility Workflows
draftBody:
Dear Victoria,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to introduce CapSigma and explore how we can support Harris Health System in optimizing your financial assistance eligibility workflows and enhancing your revenue cycle.

Our disciplined approach to data operations includes forms and records digitization, data cleansing, and operational support tailored for healthcare organizations. Given your focus on revenue-cycle optimization and reducing denials, I believe our services can help streamline your eligibility processes, particularly around online applications and document intake.

We offer a no-cost pilot to demonstrate our capabilities in improving your eligibility-document intake and access workflows. This could be a valuable opportunity to assess how we can contribute to your goals of enhanced collections and operational capacity.

I would welcome the chance to discuss this further at your convenience.

Best regards,

Niyi Olumide, PMP, CSM  
General Manager, CapSigma
